observations: Several large solar panels leaning against a white textured wall.
The dark, uniform color of the cells suggests mono-crystalline construction.
The panels appear to have a half-cut cell design, indicated by the horizontal split in the middle.
A watermark 'PRIME ELITE ENERGY' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' is visible across the center.
No manufacturer branding, model numbers, or technical specifications are visible on the front of the panels.

claims.evidence: The panels are shown leaning against an outdoor wall without protective packaging.
Efficiency ratings require laboratory testing or a verified datasheet linked to a specific model.
Charging speed depends on the panel's wattage, the charge controller, and the battery state.
The dark, uniform appearance of the cells in photo 0 is characteristic of mono-crystalline silicon.

risks.proof: A clear photo of the technical specification label on the back of the panel.
A video showing a multimeter reading the Open Circuit Voltage (Voc) in clear sunlight.
A photo of the manufacturer's label and serial number.

proof_requests: Photo of the technical specification sticker on the back of the panel showing wattage, voltage, and brand.
Close-up photo of the frame corners to check for previous mounting marks (to verify 'brand new' claim).
Photo of the junction box and MC4 connectors on the back.
response.reason: The wattage and brand are the most critical factors for pricing solar panels and neither is visible in the provided photo. A shot of the specification label on the back is mandatory.
